plan.title: Donation Dashboard
plan.subtitle: An overview of donation activity.

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT City, sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Donors
panels.sql: SELECT Donor, sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Payment Mode Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT Mode, sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides a snapshot of donation activity. The monthly trend shows donation amounts over time, helping to identify patterns and seasonality.  {{p1.total}} represents the total amount donated.  {{p2.total}} shows the top cities contributing to donations.  {{p5.total}} illustrates the distribution of payment methods used for donations.  The top donors are listed in panel {{p4}}.
